_comment: Style-of-play scoring config. Axis scores are proxies relative to each season's league; they are not CIES scores. sign +1 means a higher KPI value pushes toward the RIGHT-hand label. Formulas live in style.py (by KPI id); everything else is here.
tie_rule: Competition ranking: clubs with identical (to 1e-12) axis values share the best rank of the group and the next rank is skipped; rank 1 is furthest toward the right-hand label.

central_rectangle.description: Shooter-perspective rectangle in front of goal: x >= 0.843 (the 16.5 m line of a 105 m pitch) and |y - 0.5| <= 0.13. A documented assumption, configurable here.
central_rectangle.status: defined, not computed: league-wide shot coordinates would need every match of every club (about 4,560 requests)

style_def_line.label: Defensive line
style_def_line.description: How high the team defends. Toward High: few deep completions allowed and a larger share of the shots conceded coming from fast attacks (a high line is exposed to quick breaks). A proxy from Understat team data.

style_def_press.label: Pressing
style_def_press.description: How actively the team wins the ball high. Toward Active: lower PPDA (passes allowed per defensive action) and more defensive actions in the opposition's 40%. The two KPIs share a source and are correlated.

style_def_tight.label: Box protection
style_def_tight.description: How little the team lets in near goal. Toward Tight: fewer shots and less xG conceded from inside the box. The central-rectangle KPI is not computed (needs league-wide shot coordinates).

style_bu_length.label: Build-up length
style_bu_length.unavailable_reason: Pass length needs pass-level event data, which Understat does not provide. No honest proxy exists in shot data.
style_bu_length.description: How long or short the team's passes are when building from the back.

style_bu_direction.label: Build-up direction
style_bu_direction.unavailable_reason: Pass direction needs pass-level event data, which Understat does not provide. No honest proxy exists in shot data.
style_bu_direction.description: Whether the team builds forward quickly or circulates the ball sideways.

style_bu_complexity.label: Build-up complexity
style_bu_complexity.description: How elaborate the team's possession is. Toward Elaborate: a larger share of shots from slow attacks and a larger share of xGChain that comes from build-up (xGBuildup). A weak proxy: there is no pass data.

style_att_aerial.label: Attack medium
style_att_aerial.unavailable_reason: Needs shot type and last action for every club's shots (headers, crosses). Understat only gives those per match or per player, about 4,560 requests league-wide. Supply att_header_share and att_cross_share in data/external/style_kpis.csv to enable it.
style_att_aerial.description: Whether chances come through the air (headers, crosses) or on the ground.

style_att_tempo.label: Attack tempo
style_att_tempo.description: Whether attacks are quick or patient. Toward Placed: a smaller share of shots and xG from fast attacks (Understat's own attack-speed classification).

style_att_grouping.label: Attack spacing
style_att_grouping.description: How concentrated the team's attacking is. Toward Grouped: a larger share of shots from inside the box and more deep completions per shot. Central-lane share and shot dispersion are not computed (need league-wide coordinates).

def_fast_conceded_share.label: Share of shots conceded from fast attacks

def_actions_pm.label: Defensive actions in the opposition 40% per match

def_inbox_xga_pm.label: xGA from in-box shots per match

def_central_box_shots_pm.label: Shots conceded from the central rectangle per match

bu_slow_share_shots.label: Share of shots from slow attacks

bu_buildup_share.label: xGBuildup as a share of xGChain

att_header_share.label: Share of shots that are headers

att_cross_share.label: Share of open-play shots from a cross
att_cross_share.source: external only: league-wide shot last action

att_fast_share_shots.label: Share of shots from fast attacks

att_fast_share_xg.label: Share of xG from fast attacks

att_inbox_share.label: Share of shots taken inside the box

att_central_lane_share.label: Share of open-play shots from the central lane
